text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cabinet will prosecute officials responsible for building errors in state-owned apartment blocks in Medinet Nasr and Qattamiyah. State to bravely reveal any other construction errors.
- Policeman shot by mistake outside house of (former interior minister) Nabawi Ismail.
- Egypt reiterates its willingness to join in a Great Lakes multinational force.
- Cabinet says President Mubarak's talks in Libya and Tunis have had good results.
- Treasure of old coins found while restoring the Egyptian National Library.
- Egypt to build another highway to Libya by 1997. Highway to run parallel to coastal road and through the Siwa Oasis.
